settings.title: Settings
settings.focusModeDesc: When a session is selected, fade unselected session items, chat header, input area, settings button, and inactive right-panel tabs

settings.baseUrlPlaceholder: Leave empty to use default URL

settings.logNotFound: Log not found or has been cleared.
settings.capVisionDesc: Allow the model to receive and understand image content
settings.capImageOutputDesc: Allow the model to generate image output
settings.capFunctionCallingDesc: Allow the model to invoke external tools and functions
settings.capAudioInputDesc: Allow the model to receive and process audio data
settings.capAudioOutputDesc: Allow the model to generate speech or audio output
settings.capPdfInputDesc: Allow the model to directly read and parse PDF files
settings.toolSshDesc: Save SSH credentials for quick connection. AI can initiate connections but cannot see your saved credentials.
settings.toolSshSecurityWarning: Do not save critical credentials to avoid potential financial loss.
settings.toolSshNameHint: Unique name the AI uses to reference this credential
settings.toolSshEmptyHint: Add credentials to let AI connect to remote servers directly
settings.toolSshProxyUrlHint: Optional SOCKS5/4 proxy for SSH connections
settings.toolDbDesc: Save database credentials for quick connection. AI can initiate connections but cannot see the credential contents.
settings.toolDbSecurityWarning: Do not save critical credentials to avoid potential financial loss.
settings.toolDbNameHint: Unique name the AI uses to reference this database connection
settings.toolDbReadonlyHint: Restricts AI to SELECT queries only (recommended)

settings.toolDbEmptyHint: Add credentials to let AI query remote databases directly
settings.toolBrowserDesc: Configure the embedded browser panel that the AI uses via the browser tool.
settings.toolBrowserIgnoreCertificateErrorsHint: When off, you'll be prompted on self-signed / untrusted certificates. When on, all certificate errors are silently bypassed.
settings.toolBrowserSecurityWarning: Warning: enabling this bypasses ALL HTTPS certificate validation (self-signed, expired, mismatched hostnames) — including potential phishing sites. Only enable this on trusted internal networks.
settings.toolBrowserSavedSitesDesc: Hosts that have stored cookies in the embedded browser partition.
settings.mcpDesc: Configure MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to extend AI with more tool capabilities.

settings.hooksBuiltinPathSafety: Prevents writing to system folders and credential files.
